snippet.title: 2026 Total Solar Eclipse (Official NASA Trailer)
snippet.description:
The Sun and Moon are coming together to put on a show for Earth, and we'll be sharing it with you.

On Aug. 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will be visible in parts of Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and a small corner of Portugal.

Viewers in other places in the Northern Hemisphere will also have the chance to experience a partial solar eclipse, including parts of the U.S. (from Alaska to North Carolina), most of Canada, much of Europe, and northwestern Africa.

We'll be broadcasting the eclipse live, so you can experience totality from anywhere.

Learn how to watch totality live with us: https://go.nasa.gov/4ftKdXd
Learn more about this solar spectacle: https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/total-solar-eclipse-on-august-12-2026/

Credit: NASA

snippet.title: Season 4: Heroes of Busan Official Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Let your teamwork do all the talking during Season 4: Heroes of Busan.

The leader of MEKA Squad is ready for her highly anticipated debut as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon! Take the fight straight to Talon and the Junkers with her close range Plasma Saber and protective Power Barrier.

D.Mon isn’t the only MEKA Squad pilot showing up this season. During our Shooting Star: My MEKA Mania Event, you’ll get a chance to support your favorite MEKA pilot by completing challenges, earning rewards, and seeing which one is the most popular of them all.

Battle Passes are getting revamped this season by letting you choose which track to unlock rewards in first, and by letting you swap an eligible Legendary reward for something in the curated Swap Pool.

Competitive is also getting updated with the all-new Emerald Rank, Comp Rank Reset, and the arrival of Team Drives that reward you for teaming up and sticking together as a group.

And that’s just the beginning! Look out for brand new map reworks, Mythics, the return of a fan-favorite collab, and so much more.

It all starts when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches in-game tomorrow at 11am PT.

snippet.title: Dulce Sabor A Muerte - Tráiler Oficial
snippet.description:
4 DE SEPTIEMBRE SOLO EN CINES. 

El director y guionista Eli Roth (Hostel, Black Friday), que debutó con su éxito La cabaña sangrienta en el Festival de Toronto, ahora nos propone un giro a las historias sobre padres e hijos para narrar qué puede ocurrir cuando lo que parece ser algo inocente y sin preocupaciones —un helado en mitad de un caluroso verano— se puede convertir en tu peor pesadilla. 

Cuando un misterioso heladero desata una maldición que convierte a los niños en asesinos, tres amigos que lograron escapar deberán descubrir el origen del horror y detenerlo antes de que el verano perfecto se transforme en una pesadilla y todo su tranquilo vecindario sucumba al caos.
